thought.text: All containers are up, Keycloak is healthy, and dev servers are starting. Let me continue monitoring the spring-app health and seeding:

reasoning_content:
Great progress! All containers are up:
- urbo-workspace-spring-app-1: Up (health: starting) — backend is starting up
- urbo-workspace-keycloak-1: healthy
- sendinblue, meilisearch, localstack, sample-images, postgres, imgproxy, mailpit: up
- urbo-proxy: up

Dev servers have started (boards/urboards is already showing "Successfully ran target serve").

Waiting for the following:
1. spring-app to become healthy (health check at :8081/health)
2. sample-data-loader to run and complete seeding
3. Dev servers (app, cms, boards) to become ready

Let's keep monitoring.
